title: Deploying Local LLMs & RAG Pipelines in Production
excerpt: A practical guide to implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using self-hosted vector databases, semantic search, and quantized models.
content:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation bridges proprietary contextual data with the generative power of Large Language Models without costly fine-tuning cycles.

### Vector Indexing & Hybrid Search
Combining keyword lexical BM25 search with dense vector embeddings produces state-of-the-art retrieval recall for enterprise documentation and customer knowledge bases.

```python
def hybrid_search(query: str, top_k: int = 5):
    sparse_results = bm25_index.search(query, k=top_k * 2)
    dense_results = vector_db.similarity_search(query, k=top_k * 2)
    return reciprocal_rank_fusion(sparse_results, dense_results)[:top_k]
```

Optimizing chunk sizes (512 tokens with 10% overlap) significantly minimizes hallucination rates in production bots.

title: Designing Resilient Distributed Event-Driven Architectures
excerpt: Core principles of idempotency, dead-letter queues, outbox patterns, and saga orchestrations in enterprise distributed systems.
content:
In distributed microservices, network partitions and transient failures are inevitable. Designing systems around the Transactional Outbox Pattern prevents dual-write inconsistencies between relational databases and message brokers.

### The Transactional Outbox Pattern
By persisting events within the same ACID database transaction as business entities, a background CDC (Change Data Capture) or poller worker guarantees at-least-once message delivery to Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
